CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red locations), an explicit organization/access origin, and a separate origin/status field are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking processing condition to the same content's presentation/access is asserted.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified contents (red, blue) with location sets.

D.rationale: Content entries are presented separately from explicit origin/status metadata for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report states how content is presented (grid orientation) and includes explicit origin/access metadata describing representation.
